# netbox_data_source (Data Source)

A NetBox data source (core.datasource): a git repository, S3 bucket or local path NetBox synchronises files from.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/core/datasource/):

> A data source represents some external repository of data which NetBox can consume, such as a git repository. Files within the data source are synchronized to NetBox by saving them in the database as [data file](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/core/datafile/) objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_data_source" "test" {
  name = "test-data_source"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether NetBox synchronises from this source.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `source_url` (String) URL or path of the source.
- `status` (String) Synchronisation status reported by NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `file_count` (Number) Number of files synced from the data source.
- `ignore_rules` (String) Newline-separated glob patterns of files to ignore when synchronising.
- `last_synced` (String) When NetBox last synchronised the source.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `parameters` (String) Backend-specific parameters as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `sync_interval` (Number) Automatic synchronisation interval in minutes. One of: 1, 60, 720, 1440, 10080, 43200.
- `type` (String) Kind of backing store. One of: local, git, amazon-s3.
- `url` (String)
